title: Argentum AI signs $630M data center collaboration with Kyndryl to deploy NVIDIA GPUs
summary: 20-year, 10-megawatt agreement underpins deployment of B300 systems for AI inference
body_markdown:
**SAN FRANCISCO and NEW YORK, November 17, 2026** —[Argentum AI](https://argentum-ai.com/) , a premium GPU cloud provider, and[Kyndryl](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced a 20-year, $630M data center collaboration for an initial 10 megawatts (MW) of capacity at Kyndryl’s Boulder, Colorado, facility to power deployment of NVIDIA GPU systems.


Argentum is deploying NVIDIA B300 systems at the site in a fully Tier III environment, creating advanced, enterprise-grade infrastructure to run demanding AI applications at scale. Deployment is underway.


The agreement provides Argentum access to a facility built for the power density of current-generation GPU systems and gives Argentum’s customers a faster path to high-performance inference capacity.


“Partnering with an established technology services and infrastructure provider like Kyndryl is an important milestone for Argentum AI,” said Andrew Sobko, Founder and CEO, Argentum AI. “This agreement reflects our shared commitment to expanding secure, high-performance compute infrastructure and supporting the growing demands of enterprises embracing AI at scale.”


“Our agreement gives us a unique opportunity to put Kyndryl capacity to work in an innovative way, this coupled with our mission-critical capabilities, decades of operational and services experience will support Argentum as it creates capacity for its customers,” said Jamie Rutledge, President, Kyndryl U.S.


The facility welcomes a fast-growing, enterprise-grade AI inference company, whose technology powers some of the world’s most widely used AI applications, as its flagship anchor tenant. Argentum AI and Kyndryl intend to broaden their collaboration to support Argentum’s growth and evolving mission-critical enterprise AI infrastructure needs.


**About Argentum AI**
Argentum AI is a premium GPU cloud provider. The company originates, finances and operates GPU clusters, delivering dedicated bare metal GPU capacity to AI model builders, inference providers and enterprises. Argentum works with data center operators and builds capacity around customer demand, with a focus on speed of delivery, reliability and long-term partnerships. For more information, visit[argentum-ai.com](https://argentum-ai.com/) .


**About Kyndryl** Kyndryl (NYSE: KD) is a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, offering advisory, implementation and managed service capabilities to thousands of customers in more than 60 countries. As the world’s largest IT infrastructure services provider, the company designs, builds, manages and modernizes the complex information systems that the world depends on every day. For more information, visit[www.kyndryl.com](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) .
